attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page calls him an English saint and gives no life, no rank and no year, so this folder carries no `types` and no `dates`; the corpus's other men of this name are kept on other days and nothing on this page joins them. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
